newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Brown - Jobs and budget discipline are compatible.
newsitem.headline: Brown - Jobs and budget discipline are compatible.

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown said on Monday there was no contradiction between job creation and tough budgetary discipline.

"Budget discipline is absolutely critical and so is price stability," Brown said. "But I don't see any contradiction between price stability, budgetary discipline and job creation," he said. Brown is in Luxembourg pushing proposals to created jobs in the European Union. He circulated a paper on his plans to his EU counterparts on Sunday night. The finance ministers are meeting in Luxembourg for their monthly Ecofin.
The paper laid out three major points for discussion -- job creation and employability, opportunities for small businesses and completing the EU single market.

Earlier, Brown told Reuters Financial Television that his jobs proposal had won support among EU finance ministers. "What I've found today is that there is general support for what I am proposing. "Jobs and growth should be at the centre of the EU agenda," he said.
